# foundry_connections (Data Source)

Lists the connections configured on the Foundry account and project. Connections are created and managed outside this provider, typically with `azurerm_ai_foundry` or `azurerm_ai_services_connection`. Use this data source to look up a connection name for the `connection_name` attribute of `foundry_dataset` and `foundry_index`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foundry_connections" "available" {}

# Use a connection name to back a dataset or index.
output "storage_connection" {
  value = one([
    for connection in data.foundry_connections.available.connections :
    connection.name if connection.type == "AzureStorageAccount"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connections` (Attributes List) Connections available to the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Azure Resource Manager ID of the connection.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default connection of its type for the project.
- `name` (String) Connection name, used as `connection_name` on datasets and indexes.
- `target` (String) Endpoint or resource ID the connection points to.
- `type` (String) Connection type, such as `AzureStorageAccount` or `CognitiveSearch`.
